title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 81
paragraphs: Accordingly Aristides came forward and told them this, saying that he had come from Aegina and had barely escaped detection by those who were blockading them, for the whole Greek encampment was encircled by the ships of Xerxes, and he urged them to prepare to defend themselves. Having said this, he withdrew, and among them dispute broke out again, for most of the commanders did not believe what they had been told.
